pages.title: Normal
pages.text: $(bold)Command:$() /wnt taxpolicy set NORMAL$(br2)The default policy. No modifiers are applied to revenue or happiness. Use this when you have no pressing economic need and want predictable results.

pages.title: Low Tax
pages.text: $(bold)Command:$() /wnt taxpolicy set LOW$(br2)Reduces tax revenue by $(bold)25%$() but adds $(bold)+0.2$() to citizen happiness growth each cycle.$(br2)Best used when your colony happiness is low, you are recovering from a war penalty, or you want to reduce the chance of negative random events.

pages.title: High Tax
pages.text: $(bold)Command:$() /wnt taxpolicy set HIGH$(br2)Increases tax revenue by $(bold)25%$() but reduces citizen happiness growth by $(bold)0.15$() each cycle.$(br2)Best used for short bursts when you need gold quickly — for example, to fund a treasury before declaring war or purchasing upgrades.

pages.title: War Economy
pages.text: $(bold)Command:$() /wnt taxpolicy set WAR_ECONOMY$(br2)Increases tax revenue by $(bold)50%$() but reduces happiness growth by $(bold)0.25$() per cycle. The harshest policy available.$(br2)Sustained use risks negative events like Guard Desertion, Labor Strike, and Plague Outbreak. Switch back to Normal or Low once you have the funds you need.
